payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Does the EDITED image show the original blue mug still remaining at its SOURCE position to the left of the headphones?
node.criteria: Pass if the original blue mug is visibly no longer remaining at its SOURCE position left of the headphones. Fail if a recognizable remnant of that source mug remains there. Unknown if the left-side image evidence does not permit determining whether the source mug remains.
node.binding: Assess whether the source blue mug remains at its original left-of-headphones position; do not count unrelated objects or indistinct artifacts as the mug unless visually recognizable as its remnant.
node.source_quote: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
node.endpoint: The original blue mug is no longer visibly remaining at its SOURCE position to the left of the headphones.
node.necessity: A right-side mug alone does not establish that the requested mug was moved; the visible source-position blur makes departure from the original position a distinct, necessary part of evaluating the requested move.

node_traces.evidence: In the EDITED image, a large blue, mug-shaped blurred remnant remains on the tabletop at the original position to the left of the headphones, matching the source mug's location. It is visibly recognizable as a remnant rather than just an unrelated object.
